title: tragopogon gonocarpus
intro: Tragopogon gonocarpus, commonly known as Safflower or False Safflower, is a flowering plant species in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its numerous health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Tragopogon gonocarpus include its ability to reduce inflammation and pain, as well as its antiseptic and antifungal properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
